questions.label: Do any of the following describe you, someone who lives in your household, or anyone in your care?
options: Has had a baby (or been pregnant) within the last 6 months
Is currently breastfeeding a baby that is less than 12 months old
Is a baby, child or foster child under the age of 5
questions.note: Several WIC categories in one list; the pregnant rule covers only the first. Proposed rule: wicCategories.

questions.label: Including you, is anyone in your household currently enrolled in any of the following programs?
options: Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations (FDPIR)
questions.note: Asks about current enrollment, not applications.

questions.label: How many people are in your household?
My household has no income
questions.note: Checked only when the household has no income at all.

questions.label: Income Type
options: Wages, Tips and Commission (before tax and deductions)
Social Security Benefits (SS, SSI, Survivors, and Disability/SSDI)
Retirement Payments or Benefits, Including Pensions and Annuities
questions.note: One row per income source; the profile saves totals, not sources.

questions.label: Dollar Amount
questions.note: The amount of one income source.
